title.zh: 冠军之铸现场秀！比武会

texts.zh: 几十年过去了，一场新的锦标赛即将拉开帷幕。派你的舰队进入聚光灯下，向星系证明你的智慧、力量和决心。
texts.en: Decades have passed, and a new tournament is about to begin. Send your fleets into the spotlight and prove to the galaxy your wit, might, and determination.

title.zh: 太空城邦：冠军之铸现场秀！

texts.zh:
啊，一位熟悉的老对手回到了演播室！但你是否带上了什么新式武器？

我们的观众和星系竞技场都在拭目以待！
texts.en:
Ah, a familiar contender returns to the Broadcast! But are you packing any new heat?

Our audience, and the galactic arena await!

texts.zh:
欢迎回来，选手！赌池已经热火朝天，粉丝们正渴望看到更多精彩表现，而我们刚刚清理完残骸。

想再破一次收视纪录吗？
texts.en:
Welcome back, contestant! The betting pools are red hot, the fans are baying for more, and we've just finished clearing the debris.

Care to break another viewership record?

texts.zh:
哎呀呀！这不是我们最爱的战争贩子兼公共表演赞助人吗。我们正在筹备下一场舰队肉搏战……

你想参与到主场赛事吗？
texts.en:
Well, well! If it isn't our favorite warmonger-slash-patron of public spectacle. We're prepping the next fleet melee...

Would you like to be the main event?

texts.zh: 冠军之铸太空城邦没有回应我们的呼唤。
texts.en: The Champion's Forge Enclave won't respond to our hails.

texts.zh: 别说翻译了，只要我们发给[From.GetName]讯息，他们就立马下线，拒绝与我们交流。
texts.en: Translations aside, once we exchanged our information with [From.GetName] the signal went dark and they refused to speak to us.

texts.zh:
我就知道你可以的！

我们会再联系。
texts.en:
Knew you had it in you!

We will be in touch.

label.en: Tell us more about your events.

texts.zh:
把赢到的奖金留在桌上不拿？真是太浪费了！

不过，如果你改变主意并且能找到我们，冠铸秀始终欢迎赢家。
texts.en:
Leaving your winnings on the table? What a waste!

Well, if you change your mind, and you can find us, the CFL always welcomes winners.

label.zh: 我们登记报名，准备参加下一轮比武会。
label.en: Register us for the next show.

label.zh: 详细说说你们的活动赛事。
label.en: Tell us more about your events.

texts.zh: 啊，你是在找个新人吗？战士、掮客、旅者……他们可不是那种你看一眼就会过忘的货色，这星系也难得让他们销声匿迹太久。我们在旅途中确实遇到过几位。但朋友，在这片地界，天下没有免费的午餐。付了我们的猎头费，我就为你安排见面。
texts.en: Ah, looking for someone new for your roster? Warriors, fixers, wayfarers... Not the sort you forget, and the galaxy rarely lets them drift far for long. We have encountered a few in our travels. But nothing's free out here, friend. Pay our scouting fee, and I'll arrange an introduction.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

title.zh: 冠铸秀：战斗简报大放送

texts.zh:
嘿，挑战者！你的战斗简报已经过时，而战术局势总是瞬息万变。新对手、新舰队战术，还有新出现的突破口。

我们的分析师已经为你准备了一份署着你名字的全新档案。条件不变，火力优势不变。想要吗？
texts.en:
Hey there, contender! Your combat briefing has gone stale, and the tactical scene never holds still for long. New rivals, new fleet doctrines, fresh soft spots opening up.

Our analysts already have a fresh dossier prepped with your name on it. Same terms, same firepower edge. Want it?

title.zh: 太空城邦：冠军之铸现场秀！

texts.zh:
欢迎加入冠铸秀！这里是铸就传奇的摇篮，也是星际梦想启航的地方。我们漫游于星辰之间，为这个厌倦了安逸与平庸的星系提供惊险与盛况。

你的杀手锏是什么？是身手敏捷的飞行员？是令人震撼的火力？还是单纯对利润和掌声的渴望？立即报名，我们将把你塑造成一颗璀璨之星。
texts.en:
Welcome to CFL! This is where legends are forged, and stellar dreams take flight. We roam the stars, providing danger and spectacle to a galaxy grown bored of safety and routine.

What's your angle? Nimble pilots? Spectacular firepower? Or simply a taste for profit and applause? Sign up today, and we'll turn you into a star.

texts.zh:
欢迎收看“冠军之铸”现场秀！这里是全星系最顶尖的视觉与毁灭盛宴。

位于[champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]星系的下一届冠铸秀现已开放报名。一场壮丽的大乱斗正等待着大家。

准入要求：一支规模最多[champions_forge_enclave_country.GetCFLFleetSizeRequirement]舰队规模的舰队。

胜者将赢得奖励、名望以及至高无上的冠铸秀的大奖杯。

想要锻造属于你的传奇？那就报名参赛。

想要安宁与清静？没门！
texts.en:
This is Champion's Forge Live! The galaxy's premier source of spectacle and destruction.

Registration is now open for the next CFL Tournament in the [champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName] System. A glorious free-for-all awaits.

Entry requirement: a fleet of at most [champions_forge_enclave_country.GetCFLFleetSizeRequirement] Fleet Size.

Victors take the rewards, the prestige, and the grand CFL trophy.

You want to forge a legend? Sign up.

You want peace and quiet? Too bad!

texts.zh:
欢迎收看“冠军之铸”现场秀！这里是全星系最顶尖的视觉与毁灭盛宴。

位于[champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]星系的下一届冠铸秀现已开放报名。一场壮丽的大乱斗正等待着大家。

准入要求：一支规模最多[champions_forge_enclave_country.GetCFLFleetSizeRequirement]舰队规模的舰队。

胜者将赢得奖励、名望以及至高无上的冠铸秀的大奖杯。

想要锻造属于你的传奇？那就报名参赛。

想要安宁与清静？没门！

此外，我们还打算要回奖杯。
texts.en:
This is Champion's Forge Live! The galaxy's premier source of spectacle and destruction.

Registration is now open for the next CFL Tournament in the [champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName] System. A glorious free-for-all awaits.

Entry requirement: a fleet of at most [champions_forge_enclave_country.GetCFLFleetSizeRequirement] Fleet Size.

Victors take the rewards, the prestige, and the grand CFL trophy.

You want to forge a legend? Sign up.

You want peace and quiet? Too bad!

Also, we are going to need that trophy back.

label.zh: 算上我们！我们必将胜利。
label.en: Sign us up! We will be victorious.

texts.zh:
“星系各地的岩石生物、有机生命和战争机器们——欢迎回到‘冠军之铸’锦标赛的直播现场！

[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]星系的闲杂人等已经清理完毕，赌池也正炙手可热，我有一种预感，我们即将亲眼见证一些造价极其高昂的硬件烧毁报废。

各位屏幕前的观众请记住：这可不是什么例行巡逻或边界摩擦。这里是铸炉！没人能带着完整的尊严撤离。

参赛者们……创造！传奇！吧！”
texts.en:
"LITHOIDS, ORGANICS, AND WAR MACHINES ACROSS THE GALAXY - WELCOME BACK TO CHAMPION'S FORGE LIVE!

The [event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName] system has been cleared, the betting pools are on fire, and I've got a feeling we're about to witness some incredibly expensive hardware go critical.

Remember, everyone at home: this isn't just some patrol or border skirmish. This is the Forge! Nobody retreats with their pride intact.

Contestants... MAKE! IT! LEGENDARY!"

texts.zh:
[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName]恒星系内的比赛局势胶着、难解难分。舰队濒临崩溃彼此追逐环绕，无人能打出决定性一击。

但没有胜利的结局，没有人举起奖杯，也没有人登上领奖台。冠军之铸团队终于承认：无法确定胜者。参赛队伍被遣散回家，转播悄然切回重播。
texts.en:
The match in the [event_target:champions_forge_enclave_system.GetName] system dragged on without resolution. Battered fleets circled one another, none able to land the deciding blow.

But there is no triumphant finish, no trophy raised, no podium. The CFL crew finally call it: no winner could be determined. The contestant fleets are released and sent home, the broadcast quietly cut to a rerun.

title.zh: 太空城邦：冠军之铸现场秀！

texts.zh:
随着冠铸秀方舟舰的引爆，广播信号切断为黑屏。我们搜查了[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]星系中的残骸，并打捞了他们那满溢的储物仓。

他们最后的“奇观”相当有利可图……对我们而言。
texts.en:
The broadcast cuts to black as the CFL Arkship detonates. We comb the wreckage in the [champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName] system and haul in the contents of their overflowing storage bays.

Their final "spectacle" was quite profitable... for us.

texts.zh:
随着冠铸秀方舟舰的引爆，广播信号切断为黑屏。我们搜查了[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]星系中的残骸，并打捞了他们那满溢的储物仓。

他们最后的“奇观”相当有利可图……对我们而言。

我们的名字将永远作为最后一批刻在奖杯上的人……随着冠铸秀那帮蠢货的消失，再也不会有下一位冠军来挑战我们的地位了。
texts.en:
The broadcast cuts to black as the CFL Arkship detonates. We comb the wreckage in the [champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName] system and haul in the contents of their overflowing storage bays.

Their final "spectacle" was quite profitable... for us.

Our names will forever be the final ones inscribed on the trophy... and with those fools at the CFL gone, there will be no next champion to challenge our claim.

label.zh: 星系总会找到新的乐子。向来如此。
label.en: The galaxy will find new entertainment. It always does.

title.zh: 太空城邦：冠军之铸现场秀！

texts.zh:
在短短几秒钟内，星系目睹了冠铸秀的最后一场演出。

画面剧烈晃动，伴随着解说员的尖叫，随后一堵火墙吞噬了方舟舰。

接着：画面切断。

冠军之铸现场秀！位于[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]星系的太空城邦被[champions_forge_destroyer.GetName]摧毁。
texts.en:
For a few seconds, the galaxy is treated to CFL's final show.

A shaky feed with a screaming commentator followed by wall of fire swallowing the Arkship.

Then: cut to black.

The Champion's Forge Live! Enclave has been destroyed by [champions_forge_destroyer.GetName] in the [champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName] system.

texts.zh:
在短短几秒钟内，星系目睹了冠铸秀的最后一场演出。

画面剧烈晃动，伴随着解说员的尖叫，随后一堵火墙吞噬了方舟舰。

接着：画面切断。

冠军之铸现场秀！位于[champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName]星系的太空城邦被[champions_forge_destroyer.GetName]摧毁。

我们的名字将永远是刻在奖杯上的最后一批……随着冠铸秀的消亡，再也不会有新的冠军来挑战我们的地位了。
texts.en:
For a few seconds, the galaxy is treated to CFL's final show.

A shaky feed with a screaming commentator followed by wall of fire swallowing the Arkship.

Then: cut to black.

The Champion's Forge Live! Enclave has been destroyed by [champions_forge_destroyer.GetName] in the [champions_forge_destruction_system.GetName] system.

Our names will forever be the final ones inscribed on the trophy... and with the CFL gone, there will be no new champion to challenge our claim.

label.zh: 星系总会找到新的乐子。向来如此。
label.en: The galaxy will find new entertainment. It always does.

texts.zh:
那人以军人的姿态登舰，面容因悲痛和多年的流亡而变得坚毅。他的声音低沉、从容，带着钢铁般的锋利。

“我的世界被清洗了，我的族人，我的家人……唯我幸存。我隐忍至今。而那些毁灭的始作俑者，必将死于我手。”
texts.en:
The figure steps aboard with a soldier's bearing, their features hardened by grief and long years of exile. Their voice is low, measured, and edged with iron.

"My world was cleansed, my people, my family... I alone survived. I endure. And the architects of annihilation will die by my hand."

label.zh: 你能否在追求个人目标的同时，也为我们的事业效力？
label.en: Can you serve our cause while pursuing your own?

texts.zh:
敌方舰队在我们的攻击下溃败。他们的信号逐渐没入静默。

奥伦·维斯注视着监视屏，沉默不语。这场胜利中没有喜悦，只有清算。那个奉行大清洗的帝国的旗帜在虚空中燃烧，但在随后的死寂中，他们的誓言依然回荡。

“每击倒一个这样的敌人，都会磨炼我们的意志。我们将继续打击那些推行灭绝政策的人，永不言弃。”
texts.en:
The enemy fleet breaks against our assault. Their signals fade into static.

Watching on the view screen, Orun Veyth does not speak. There is no triumph in this victory, only reckoning. The banner of a purge-committing empire burns in the void, but in the silence that follows, their promise endures.

"Each such foe cast down steels our resolve. We will continue to strike against those who practice annihilation, and we will not relent.

texts.zh:
你面前站着一位穿着仪式礼袍的流浪者，饰品与织物的排列显然经过精心打理。反重力伺服器嗡嗡地震动着，驱动着一本法典漂浮在她面前。当她终于开口时，每个字听起来都不像是回答，而更像是一个未问出口的问题的回响。

“意外与命运生着别无二致的面孔，而今天它转向了你。”
texts.en:
Before you stands a wanderer robed in ceremonial layers, ornaments and fabrics arranged with deliberate care. Antigravity servos within the codex that floats before her cause it to hum and gently vibrate. When she finally speaks, each word feels less like an answer than the echo of an unasked question.

"Accident and destiny share one face, and today it turns toward you."

label.zh: 你的智慧果真如此超群吗？
label.en: Is your wisdom truly so great?

texts.zh:
眼前的身影显然已届高龄，但其目光中却流露出对发现的强烈渴望。他的动作沉稳且安静，带着那种在野外躬耕一生的谨慎与洗练。

“向您致敬。我叫小塞罗。”
texts.en:
The figure before you is plainly aged, yet his gaze betrays a restless hunger for discovery. There is a quiet steadiness to his movement, the careful economy of one who has spent a lifetime in the field.

"I bow to you. I am called Sero the Younger."

label.zh: 你为了什么而来到此地？
label.en: What brings you to this place?

label.zh: 你离开了一座博物天枢？
你希望在我们这里发现什么？
label.en: What do you hope to find with us?

label.zh: 你长得很像我们的同类。

texts.zh:
高大的合成人低下了头。它的每一个动作都精准无误，仿佛承载着漫长岁月的重量与沉重的负担。尽管身躯是金属构架，它的神态中却透着一种显而易见的感染力。一个瘦小的身影躺在它背上的摇篮里，苍白的皮肤映衬着明亮的双眼。

“我叫索拉斯单元。我和我的儿子请求通行。”
texts.en:
The tall synthetic inclines its head. Each motion is precise, as if weighted by long years and a heavy burden. Despite its metal frame, there is something unmistakably expressive in its bearing. A small figure rests in a cradle upon its back, eyes bright against pale skin.

"I am called Unit Solace. My son and I seek passage."

label.zh: 你为了什么而来到这里？
你的儿子……他情况稳定吗？

label.en: What do you hope to teach?

label.zh: 为什么要承担这样的负担？
label.en: Why take on such a burden?

label.zh: 我们是合成人。这会有问题吗？
label.en: We are synthetic. Will that be an issue?

texts.zh:
新来的人带着洪亮的笑声走近，浑身散发着喜悦的气息。他的动作轻盈自如，仿佛是一个多次躲过死神、已不再将其放在心上的人。

“我叫萨尔·哈斯克古戎。听说你喜欢冒险。给我一场战斗，让我在虚空中施展拳脚，我会给你呈现值得一看的表现。谁知道呢？也许一路上我们还会收获一些纪念品。”
texts.en:
The newcomer arrives with a booming laugh, his whole bearing radiating delight. He moves with the easy buoyancy of someone who's dodged death often enough to stop taking it personally.

"Name's Th'aal Hask'Guron. Heard you've got a taste for danger. Give me a fight and an open horizon, and I'll give you something worth watching. Who knows? Maybe we'll pick up a few souvenirs along the way."

label.en: Do you still believe in the fight?
And what do you offer us?

label.zh: 看来你以前见过我们的族人……
label.en: It looks like you've met our kind before...

texts.zh:
萨尔·哈斯克古戎露出笑容，小心翼翼地放下了一个物件。其形状难以辨认：部分是金属，部分是骨头，还有一部分完全是某种别的东西。无论它是什么，身上都带着明显的战斗痕迹。

“每场战斗都会留下些什么，但只有一部分值得保留。不如我们把它好好展示出来，如何？反正我们的空间多得是！”

他爆发出一阵肆无忌惮的响亮狂笑，仿佛这件战利品是他与星辰之间心有灵犀的一个私人笑话。
texts.en:
Th'aal Hask'Guron grins as he sets an object down with surprising care. Its shape is hard to read: part metal, part bone, part something else entirely. Whatever it is, it bears the unmistakable scars of battle.

"Every good fight leaves something behind, but only some are worth keeping. What say we display this properly, eh? It's not like we're running out of space!

He erupts into a brazen, booming laugh, as if the trophy were an inside joke shared with the stars.

texts.zh:
年轻的流浪者步出，神色从容而谨慎。漫长旅途的印记笼罩着她，但她身上同样散发出一种沉静、不容忽视的力量。

“我的名字是塞拉伦涅。我从很远的地方赶来……比我曾设想过的还要遥远。如果你们这里还有位置，我请求在此借宿一段时日。”
texts.en:
The young wanderer steps forward with careful composure. The marks of long travel cling to her, yet so does a quiet, undeniable strength.

"My name is Seralune. I've come a long way... farther than I ever thought possible. If there is room among you, I ask passage for a time."

label.zh: 你为了什么而来到这里？

label.en: What do you ask of us?

label.zh: 你与我们物种的相似程度令人惊讶。
label.en: Your resemblance to our species is uncanny.

texts.zh:
最近，塞拉伦涅的脑海中开始浮现出模糊的回忆，那是一种她也无法解释的熟悉感。据她描述，方舟号上的某些走廊让她觉得似曾相识，而星图中的某些星象布局也勾起了一种出人意料的联结感。

“我不明白为什么这些地方会吸引我，但我标注出了那些感觉……重要的地方。如果我们前往那里，或许能找回更多的记忆。”

她标出了几处与她深藏的记忆产生共鸣的坐标——这些地点本身可能也值得调查。
texts.en:
Lately, faint recollections have begun returning to Seralune, a sense of familiarity she cannot explain. She reports that certain corridors of the Arkship feel as though she has walked them before, and star patterns in our charts evoke an unexpected sense of connection.

"I don't know why these places pull at me, but I marked the points that felt... important. If we travel there, perhaps more will return."

She has highlighted several coordinates that resonate with her buried memories - locations that may also warrant investigation in their own right.

texts.zh: 模糊的记忆指引着塞拉伦涅飘向星海深处。前往那里应当能帮她想起更多往事。
texts.en: Faint memories pull Seralune toward distant points in the stars. Traveling there should help her to remember more.

texts.zh: 冠铸秀已为前往赛场准备了专用虫洞。请在截止日期前将您的舰队送达指定地点，准备铸就属于您的传奇！
texts.en: The CFL has prepared a specialized wormhole to the competition grounds. Deliver your fleet to the designated location before the deadline and prepare to forge your legacy!

sections.zh: 准入要求：一支具有至多[event_target:champions_forge_enclave_country.GetCFLFleetSizeRequirement]舰队规模的舰队。
sections.en: Entry requirement: a fleet of at most [event_target:champions_forge_enclave_country.GetCFLFleetSizeRequirement] Fleet Size.
